title: History / s
description: Seconds of play kept on screen left of the now line (5–60). A further fifth of that previews the upcoming map density.

title: Graph height / px
description: Height of the chart area (48–144 px). The readouts and axis keep their size.

title: Show strain backdrop
description: Draw the map's difficulty strain (vosu performance graph) as a faint blue silhouette behind the trace, aligned to map time.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: The small brand tag in the panel header.
